note: Every tool an agent may use. Agents cannot call a tool that is not listed here AND in their own AGENT.md tools_allowed. Implementations live in roa/tools; the loader cross-checks both directions.

read_pricing_snapshot.description: Current published rate for the property and stay date.

read_occupancy.description: Occupancy percentage for the period in question.

read_rate_configuration.description: Rate configuration (offsets, floor/ceiling) and whether it changed.

read_inventory.description: Rooms remaining at the time of booking.

read_lrv_update_log.description: Days since the LRV was last updated by the optimizer.

read_occupancy_forecast.description: Occupancy forecast and the same period last year.
